scope: Source-informed regional experiment with audio-derived Doppler timing/frequency priors and refinement seeded only from new regional candidates. Event selection, regional coverage, date and terrain remain prior information.

review.basis: Same two previously acoustically associated main-event groups; their complete automatic ridges are retained. No new flight-search result chooses, clips, rescales or edits a measurement.

refinement.edge_policy: Report boundary/incomplete coverage; do not recenter using any evaluation coordinate or silently claim a unique global optimum.

audio_fit_policy: Use the native broad-domain defaults and independent analytic controls. Native source/default hashes are frozen before the first production fit. No parameter is tuned to a flight identity, old acoustic fit or evaluation coordinate. If fit diagnostics cannot support safe derived priors, retain an inconclusive outcome without substituting manual priors.
software_integrity_gates: All selected measured times/frequencies and original gaps remain unchanged through fit and search.
No old manual event/frequency/timing/coarse/fine values enter native fitting or generated search priors.
Geometry, normalized track data and date/time-origin assumptions are preserved and hashed.
Native fit status and identifiability/boundary diagnostics are explicit; empirical stability envelopes are not calibrated confidence intervals.
All generated timing/frequency/coarse priors agree with the published native fit derivation.
New regional results alone seed top distinct ordered flight-pair refinement; each retained pair receives its own local and fine terrain grid.
All outputs remain location_verified false and failures/no-candidate/inconclusive stages remain distinguishable.
Source, scripts, native executable, contract and data hashes remain unchanged during the production run.
Both new regional prediction and every conditional refinement finish before parsing old winner/results and coordinate references.

scientific_outcomes.scope_note: Absolute UTC, atmospheric state, complete aircraft coverage and true surveyed microphone position are not established by audio fitting.

evaluation_isolation: Source files and old results may be hashed as opaque bytes before production. Evaluation content is parsed after predictions; procedural separation on one filesystem, not a sealed holdout.

search_padding_policy.interpretation: Fixed engineering allowance around empirical fit envelopes, not calibrated confidence limits. Cover both padded timing intervals when deriving pair separation tolerance.
